ISLAMABAD, Nov 18 (APP): The Indus River System Authority (IRSA) on Saturday released 89,400 cusecs water from various rim stations with inflow of 64,500 cusecs. According to the data released by IRSA, the water level in River Indus at Tarbela Dam was 1508.41 feet, which was 108.41 feet above its dead level of 1,398 feet. Inflow of water in the dam was recorded as 24,200 cusecs while outflow as 42,000 cusecs. The water level in River Jhelum at Mangla Dam was 1187.05 feet, which was 137.05 feet above its dead level of 1,050 feet. The inflow and outflow of water was recorded 6,800 cusecs and 32,000 cusecs, respectively. The release of water at Kalabagh, Taunsa, Guddu, Sukkur and Kotri was recorded as 39,600, 31,800, 25,000, 11,200 and 1,500 cusecs respectively. Similarly, from River Kabul at Nowshera 9,600 cusecs and from Chenab at Marala 4,900 cusecs of water was released.
